description: Log a supplement dose for the signed-in user. Omit `supplement` to log the user's whole stack for the day. Defaults to today / taken. Relay any `warnings`, `coverageNotice` and `medicineNotices` in the result: the last two are about the user's medicines and are said once. Relay `experimentHolds` too (pharmacist ruling 279): an experiment of that supplement holds the next optional dose, and its `message` says which answer to update and how; never tell the user to stop prescribed medicine. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_track_log
